# Bad Decisions Examples
# Demonstrates DECISION-001 to DECISION-004

# ERROR DECISION-001: Missing ai_check_interval
# ERROR: CK3314
# ERROR: CK3872
bad_decision_001 = {
	picture = "gfx/interface/illustrations/decisions/decision_misc.dds"

	desc = bad_decision_001_desc

	is_shown = {
		is_ruler = yes
	}

	is_valid = {
		gold >= 100
	}

	effect = {
		add_gold = 100
		add_prestige = 50
	}

	# ERROR DECISION-001: Missing ai_check_interval
	# Should have: ai_check_interval = 60

	ai_potential = {
		always = yes
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		base = 100
	}
}

# Missing effect block
bad_decision_002 = {
	picture = "gfx/interface/illustrations/decisions/decision_misc.dds"

	desc = bad_decision_002_desc

	is_shown = {
		is_ruler = yes
	}

	is_valid = {
		gold >= 100
	}

	cost = {
		gold = 100
	}

# Missing effect block
	# Decision has no actual effect when taken

	ai_check_interval = 60

	ai_potential = {
		always = yes
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		base = 100
	}
}

# No is_shown or is_valid
bad_decision_003 = {
	picture = "gfx/interface/illustrations/decisions/decision_misc.dds"

	desc = bad_decision_003_desc

# Missing is_shown
# Missing is_valid
	# Decision will always be available to everyone

	effect = {
		add_gold = 100
	}

	ai_check_interval = 60

	ai_potential = {
		always = yes
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		base = 100
	}
}

# Effects but no cost/validity check
bad_decision_004 = {
	picture = "gfx/interface/illustrations/decisions/decision_misc.dds"

	desc = bad_decision_004_desc

	is_shown = {
		is_ruler = yes
	}

# is_valid exists but has no actual checks
	is_valid = {
		always = yes
	}

	# No cost field

# Gives benefits with no cost or real requirements
	effect = {
		add_gold = 1000
		add_prestige = 500
		add_piety = 250
	}

	ai_check_interval = 60

	ai_potential = {
		always = yes
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		base = 100
	}
}

# Multiple errors combined
bad_decision_all_errors = {
	picture = "gfx/interface/illustrations/decisions/decision_misc.dds"

	desc = bad_decision_all_errors_desc

# No is_shown
# No is_valid

# No effect block

	# ERROR DECISION-001: No ai_check_interval

	# Has AI logic but nothing to check
	ai_potential = {
		always = yes
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		base = 100
	}
}

# ERROR DECISION-001: Missing ai_check_interval (but has AI logic)
bad_decision_no_interval = {
	picture = "gfx/interface/illustrations/decisions/decision_misc.dds"

	desc = bad_decision_no_interval_desc

	is_shown = {
		is_ruler = yes
	}

	is_valid = {
		gold >= 100
	}

	effect = {
		add_prestige = 50
	}

	# ERROR DECISION-001: Has ai_potential and ai_will_do but no ai_check_interval
	ai_potential = {
		is_at_war = no
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		base = 100

		modifier = {
			factor = 2
			has_trait = ambitious
		}
	}
}

# Effect block is empty
bad_decision_empty_effect = {
	picture = "gfx/interface/illustrations/decisions/decision_misc.dds"

	desc = bad_decision_empty_effect_desc

	is_shown = {
		is_ruler = yes
	}

	is_valid = {
		gold >= 100
	}

	cost = {
		gold = 100
	}

# Empty effect block
	effect = {
	}

	ai_check_interval = 60

	ai_potential = {
		always = yes
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		base = 100
	}
}

# Free lunch decision
bad_decision_free_lunch = {
	picture = "gfx/interface/illustrations/decisions/decision_misc.dds"

	desc = bad_decision_free_lunch_desc

	is_shown = {
		is_ruler = yes
	}

# No meaningful validation
	is_valid = {
		is_adult = yes # Always true if shown
	}

	# No cost

# Huge benefits with no cost
	effect = {
		add_gold = 5000
		add_prestige = 2000
		add_piety = 1000
		add_character_modifier = {
			modifier = super_blessed
			years = 100
		}
	}

	ai_check_interval = 1 # AI checks every month!

	ai_potential = {
		always = yes
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		base = 10000 # AI always takes this
	}
}

# Only has effect and picture
bad_decision_minimal = {
	picture = "gfx/interface/illustrations/decisions/decision_misc.dds"

# No is_shown - available to everyone
# No is_valid - no requirements
# No effect block (only AI logic)
	# ERROR DECISION-001: No ai_check_interval

	desc = bad_decision_minimal_desc
}
